spawn: One attacker engine in fortified town siege only; reserve upper-left cells before deployment and keep approach cells reachable.
damage: Keep rulesProfile.combat.siege.catapultDamage, currently1 structureHP; guaranteed valid aimed hit.
activation: One explicit attacker-controlled engine phase after normal and waiting creature queues, before next round begins; fire or skip.
targetFallback: None. If target destroyed or invalid, ask player to choose; never silently shoot another structure.
receivingDamage: Targetable by enemy legal melee/ranged damaging attacks, using engine Defense and actual remaining HP. Not a city structure. Affected by direct damaging spells, not mind/life/poison effects.
noTargets: Auto-skip empty engine phase with explanatory log; no fake shot.
destroyed: Immediately cancel pending shot, make wreck nonblocking, no future firing this siege. No repair/resurrect in battle.
compatibility: Existing saved active siege retains legacy behavior; enable new engine only when creating a new battle under feature.
balance: 120HP/Defense6 proposed, not playtested; applies all six town styles.
